symptom: The research-only reconciliation loop used rows.length repeatedly and returned rows.length as sourceRows. A Node 22.16.0 synthetic two-row Proxy with a length getter returning zero visited zero own-index rows; the pre-fix mapper had the same live-length loop and could therefore report PASS with no mapped records despite a populated underlying array. This is synthetic metadata behavior, not a production incident or independently authenticated source evidence.
lesson: Own-index iteration alone does not establish source-array membership if the loop bound and final count are reread through a caller-controlled Proxy length getter. A false zero length can silently turn a nonempty research source into an apparent empty PASS.
guardrail: At the Node-only research reconciliation ingress, reject Proxy source-array containers, including revoked Proxies, before consulting length, own-index descriptors or caller traps. For ordinary arrays, pin the own length descriptor once for loop bounds and result counts, fail closed on sparse/accessor elements, and preserve baseline valid records and digests. A rejected untrusted container uses an explicit CONDITIONAL denial; its zero sourceRows means not counted, never an authenticated empty cohort. This does not change production or authenticate source data.
